name: card
description: A bordered surface that groups related content, like a plan, a setting group or a summary. Compose any of Card.Header (Card.Title plus subtitle text), Card.Title on its own, Card.Body and Card.Footer (actions, right-aligned). Card.Title names the card for screen readers; set its level to fit the page's heading outline. Static only: for a clickable card, put a link or button inside. The example's Button comes from the button component.

props.name: children
props.description: Any of Card.Header, Card.Title, Card.Body and Card.Footer, in reading order.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Overrides the name taken from Card.Title.

example:
<Card>
  <Card.Header>
    <Card.Title>Pro plan</Card.Title>
    $12 per month
  </Card.Header>
  <Card.Body>Unlimited projects and priority support.</Card.Body>
  <Card.Footer>
    <Button variant="secondary">Compare</Button>
    <Button>Upgrade</Button>
  </Card.Footer>
</Card>
